facts.claim: Rebate for replacing primary space or water heating equipment with new, high-efficiency natural gas units. Revised terms are effective August 17, 2026. SaskEnergy may change or cancel the program at any time without notice. Applications and paperwork must reach SaskEnergy within 120 days of installation. Approved rebates are paid by cheque, e-Transfer or account credit within 6 weeks.
facts.amount: Furnace (97.0% AFUE or higher) $325. Boiler (95.0% AFUE or higher) $750 per boiler plant up to 300 MBH. Combi boiler (95.0% AFUE or higher) $800. Tankless water heater (0.87 UEF or higher) $1,000. Condensing water heater (0.80 UEF or higher) $1,000.
facts.eligibility: Registered homeowner, landlord or rental company that pays the invoice and is a SaskEnergy residential customer. Natural gas unit in a Saskatchewan home, part of the primary heating or water heating system. Not new construction. Must be on SaskEnergy's eligible list. Installed by a gas contractor licensed through the Technical Safety Authority of Saskatchewan (self-installs are not eligible). The existing equipment must not be under manufacturer's warranty.

facts.program: SaskPower Home Efficiency Retrofit Rebate (ended April 2026)
facts.claim: SaskPower's page says the Home Efficiency Retrofit Rebate ended in April 2026 and points to its Energy Assistance Program and SaskEnergy's equipment rebate as ways to save.
facts.notes: Read in the browser on 2026-10-21. We did not find the old rebate amounts on an official page, so none are stated.

facts.claim: Free energy-saving upgrades for the home: LED light bulbs, low-flow faucet aerators, a drying rack, high-efficiency showerheads, a block heater timer, pipe wrap and a smart thermostat if eligible. Saves up to $230 a year on utility bills, says SaskPower. Steps: apply online, schedule an appointment, home visit with an energy coach, post-installation survey. Open to homeowners, renters and landlords.
facts.eligibility: Eligibility is checked through the online 'See if you qualify' tool; the income rules were not on the page text we could read.
facts.notes: Read in the browser on 2026-10-21. Administered by CLEAResult, with the Government of Canada, the City of Saskatoon and the City of Swift Current Light and Power. Phone 306-910-7304.

facts.program: Saskatchewan provincial heat pump, insulation and window rebates
facts.claim: On October 21, 2026 SaskPower's retrofit page said its Home Efficiency Retrofit Rebate had ended and listed only two ways to save: the Energy Assistance Program and SaskEnergy's Residential Equipment Replacement Rebate. We found no SaskPower or SaskEnergy rebate for heat pumps, insulation or windows.
facts.notes: A negative: we did not find one, which is not proof none exists.
